Title: Army Forge URL Source: https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/armyInfo/31xjrm9ivdimkjxp/2/preview Markdown Content: [![Image 1: Home](https://army-forge.opr-cdn.com/app/onepagerules_round_128x128.png)](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/) Havoc Brothers [Studio](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/studio "Army Forge Studio") [Sign In](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/auth/signin) GF - War Disciples v3.5.3 ## Intro Havoc Disciples are Battle Brothers who have embraced the worship of a particular Havoc God. Individually powerful and resilient, each Havoc Disciple has been molded with unique blessings by the god they follow. Stranded in the Sirius Sector, many Battle Brothers were scattered and left with little chance of survival. These desperate castaways were approached by different gods who offered powerful boons in exchange for their worship. Each god empowered their respective followers, reforging their Disciples according to their will. The Havoc Disciples are now torn between fanatical devotion to their new gods and maintaining their former discipline. ## About OPR OPR (www.onepagerules.com) is the home of many free games which are designed to be fast to learn and easy to play. This project was made by gamers for gamers and it can only exist thanks to the support of our awesome community. If you want to help us in making more awesome content, you can support us on www.patreon.com/onepagerules Thank you for playing! ## Background Story On arriving in the Sirius Sector, the Founder’s fleet was scattered and damaged. Most of these ships and their crews were discounted as destroyed, but had in fact arrived safely in Sirius far from the rest of humanity. Many believed themselves to be the sole survivors of the fleet and that they were likely the only humans in this strange new galaxy. Without any idea of how they might return to Earth, most of the scattered Battle Brothers were forced to contend with their inevitable deaths in a strange new galaxy. Humanity was not alone in this galaxy however, and the arrival of these strange interlopers drew the eyes of powerful entities in Sirius: the Havoc Gods. These gods bided their time and reached out to the Battle Brothers in their most desperate moments. Each Havoc God sought to sway these new arrivals to their influence through various gifts and boons. The God of War offered strength, allowing its Disciples to triumph over their foes. Change granted its followers knowledge and secrets, necessary for understanding their place in this new galaxy. Plague offered renewed vitality to those taken by disease. While Lust offered redemption and power to those cast out by the Battle Brothers. Those who accepted the pact were granted powerful boons by their patrons, who reforged them in their image. These Havoc Disciples repaid their gifts with a fanatical loyalty, willing to devote their lives to the god who had chosen them. Disciples began to seek each other out, forming new bands utterly dedicated to their respective god. Yet the fanaticism demanded by their faith was often at odds with the discipline required to maintain their cohesion as a unit. While some Disciples recognized organization as a necessary means to achieving their God’s goals against powerful foes, others viewed it as a mere distraction, and cared little about structure that once defined their lives as Battle Brothers. As a result, many bands are held together through brute force, as leaders struggle to preserve order amongst fanatics. Others have collapsed into marauding hordes of zealots, roving blindly through the sector as they spread havoc in the name of their god. Warbound | 265pts | 2 GF - War Disciples v3.5.3 ## Army-Wide Special Rule Warbound:Enemies that roll to block hits from this model's weapons take 1 extra wound for each unmodified result of 1 that they roll. ## Special Rules Crack:On unmodified results of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+2). Dangerous Terrain Debuff:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous Terrain once (next time the effect would apply). Melee Evasion:Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where all models have this rule. Mend:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Piercing Assault:This model gets AP(+1) when charging. Resistance:When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 2+ instead. Shred:On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Steadfast:If a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken. Unpredictable:When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Unpredictable Fighter:When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Versatile Attack:When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. Versatile Defense:When a unit where all models have this rule is deployed or activated, pick one effect: when shot or charged from over 9" away, the unit either gets +1 to defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. This effect lasts until the units' next activation. Violent:Enemies that roll to block hits from this model's weapons take 1 extra wound for each unmodified result of 1 that they roll. Warbound Boost:If this model has Warbound, when it shoots or charges enemies over 9" away, enemies taking wounds from it take extra wounds on failed defense rolls of 1-2 from Warbound (instead of only on 1). ## Aura Special Rules Furious Aura:This model and its unit get Furious. Relentless Aura:This model and its unit get Relentless. Resistance Aura:This model and its unit get Resistance. Scout Aura:This model and its unit get Scout. Steadfast Aura:This model and its unit get Steadfast. Versatile Defense Aura:This model and its unit get Versatile Defense. Warbound Boost Aura:This model and its unit get Warbound Boost. ## Army Spells **Terrifying Fury (1):** Pick one enemy unit within 18", which must take a morale test. If failed, it becomes fatigued. **Flame of Destruction (1):** Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 1 hit with Blast(3). **Fiery Protection (2):** Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Melee Evasion once (next time the effect would apply). **Brutal Massacre (2):** Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 6 hits with Crack. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger. **War Boon (3):** Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Warbound Boost once (next time the effect would apply). **Headtaker Strike (3):** Pick up to two enemy units within 12", which take 3 hits with AP(2) each. 3 GF -
